headline: Bitcoin dropped below $58,000 on Friday before bouncing back near $59,000, as a sell-off in AI and chip stocks pushed the S&P 500 into a correction and fears of a December Fed rate hike kept investors in cash.

market.asOf: BTC and SOL read from CoinMarketCap about 23:57 UTC Fri 20 Nov (06:57 Sat Bangkok); ETH from Bloomingbit (Binance price) at 21:42 UTC, because CoinMarketCap's ether figure disagreed with two other sources. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Not confirmed this run: the Alternative.me index could not be opened. The last confirmed reading, about 20:00 UTC 20 Nov, was 12 out of 100 (Extreme Fear).

stories.title: Bitcoin drops below $58,000, then climbs back near $59,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 on Friday morning in New York and kept falling into the afternoon, touching about $57,800 before bouncing. Traders who had borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, and shares of Strategy, Coinbase and Robinhood fell 20% to 30% over the week. Bitcoin is on course for a seventh losing week in a row, per Bitcoin.com News.
points: Bitcoin fell to $57,799 on Friday, its lowest price since September 2024, per Bitcoin.com News; CoinDesk had pointed to the $57,700 low from earlier this year as the bear-market floor, so the sources differ on how far back the comparison goes.

By 21:42 UTC Friday (04:42 Sat Bangkok) it was back at $59,318 on Binance, down 3.83% on the day, per Bloomingbit; it is down about 15% over the past week and about 30% over the month, per BigGo citing CoinGecko.
Bets wiped out in 24 hours reached $1.9 billion per CoinGlass data cited by Bitcoin.com News, up from "more than $1.5 billion" reported by CoinDesk earlier in the afternoon.
Strategy (MSTR) closed the week at $77.80, about 30% lower than a week earlier, and Coinbase at $101.97, about 20% lower, per Bloomingbit.

US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.2 million on Thursday 19 Nov, their third straight day of outflows, bringing November's total to about $3.47 billion, per The Block. Friday's figure was not out when this was written.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: bitcoin at a 2-year low

stories.title: AI stock sell-off turns into a Wall Street rout; Nvidia drops 14%
stories.summary: US stocks fell hard on Friday after Reuters reported that SEC staff are looking at possible accounting issues at chipmaker Nvidia. The SEC declined to comment, and an inquiry is not a finding of wrongdoing. Crypto has been trading like a risky tech stock, so bitcoin and especially bitcoin miners fell with the chip stocks. Anthropic's shares ended their second day about 7% above the IPO price.
points: The Nasdaq Composite closed down 5.28% at 22,617.73 and the S&P 500 down 3.70% at 6,910.39, putting the S&P 500 in a technical correction (10% below its high), per The Motley Fool.
Nvidia fell 14% on Friday and 23% on the week, its worst week since October 2008, per Stocktwits.
Anthropic closed at $88.62, down 8.8% from Thursday's $97.17 close and about 7% above its $83 IPO price, per StockTitan.
Some of the worst losses came from bitcoin miners: at one point MARA was down 18.6%, IREN 18% and Hut 8 17.7%, per CoinDesk's live coverage.

sources.label: The Motley Fool: stock market today, 20 Nov
Yahoo Finance: Nvidia falls on Reuters SEC report

stories.title: A December Fed rate hike looks almost certain, and investors are hiding in cash
stories.summary: The Fed meets on 8-9 December, and markets expect it to raise interest rates, not cut them. On Friday Fed Governor Lisa Cook said she had favored a hike at the October meeting. Higher rates make cash and government bonds pay more, which makes assets that pay no interest, like bitcoin and gold, less attractive.
points: Speaking in Chile on Friday, Cook said she had favored another rate hike at the October meeting and that "financial conditions remain too loose," per CoinDesk.
CME FedWatch showed about a 95.7% chance of a quarter-point hike and 4.3% for a half point, per Seoul Economic Daily on 19 Nov; Polymarket showed about 90% for a quarter-point hike.
"The place to hide is cash: two-year Treasuries at around 4.7%," STS Digital told CoinDesk.
Gold fell about 2% toward $3,500, its lowest since September 2025, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy's bitcoin is underwater
briefs.summary: Friday's $57,799 low is well below the average price of about $75,446 that Strategy paid for its bitcoin, per Bloomingbit.

briefs.title: JPMorgan: bitcoin trades far below its mining cost
briefs.summary: JPMorgan estimates it costs about $86,000 to produce one bitcoin and says "some capital has also left the crypto market altogether," per The Block.

briefs.title: Social mood hits "Extreme Fear"
briefs.summary: Santiment says the ratio of bullish to bearish crypto social media comments fell to 0.59, a level it calls an "Extreme Fear" zone, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Saylor points to demand for Strategy's preferred shares
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor says there is $5 billion to $7.5 billion of "natural, organic" demand for Strategy's STRC preferred stock at a 12% dividend, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ark buys Anthropic, trims crypto staking funds
briefs.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark bought 934,968 Anthropic shares, worth about $90.9 million, on its first trading day and trimmed its ether and Solana staking ETF holdings, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance hack funds being mixed
briefs.summary: Elliptic says launderers of the Binance hack proceeds have pushed at least 2,310 BTC, about $149 million, through mixers, roughly 90% of it since Tuesday, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto tax bill may get a House vote
briefs.summary: Rep. Horsford wants a House vote on the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, which cleared committee 38-5, before this Congress ends; paying a fee of $10 or less in crypto would not count as a gain or loss, per The Block.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Core PCE expected 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%) and headline 3.8% (prior 3.6%), per CMC Markets. Q3 GDP growth expected at 3.5% annualized, per HeadTopics. Jobless claims move up a day for Thanksgiving; the last reading was 203,000 for the week to 14 Nov, per Admiral Markets.
The Fed's survey of business conditions around the country, per the Fed's calendar. October new home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok), per the Census Bureau.
On Friday 27 Nov US stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE owner ICE. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.
Settles at 08:00 UTC, per MEXC. TokenPost puts the bitcoin expiry at about $6.67 billion.
Fed officials stop public comment on policy until after the December meeting, per the St. Louis Fed's blackout calendar.
The last jobs report before the Fed decision, per the BLS schedule. JOLTS job openings come out Tue 1 Dec at 10:00am ET; November CPI is Thu 10 Dec, the day after the Fed.
